attributes.name: Modern languages (Spanish, French)
attributes.degree_subject_requirements:
Applicants will normally be required to hold, or be expected to gain, a degree of at least a 2:2 classification, in an area with relevance to a specialist secondary subject.
We may accept applications from candidates who do not have a relevant languages degree. Where this is the case, we will assess suitability on an individual basis and may ask you to provide evidence of your proficiency based on the CEFR if you are not a native speaker of the main teaching language for which you are applying. Spoken language proficiency will also be assessed at interview.

We may ask you to complete a Subject Knowledge Enhancement (SKE) course for your main or subsidiary teaching language, the exact length of which will be determined during the PGCE interview process. Successful completion of the relevant SKE course will be a condition of your offer for entry to the PGCE programme.
attributes.additional_gcse_equivalencies:
International Applicants:

There is an expectation that international applicants will have both an IELTS Academic 7.0 overall with no less than 5.5 in each band and an English Language Qualification equivalent to GCSE English at the point of application.

With regards to GCSE English equivalents, we accept some overseas qualifications and some alternate Level 2 qualifications in English as a first language. Please note, English as a second language qualifications will not be considered.
attributes.required_qualifications:
Applicants will normally:

* hold or be expected to gain a minimum 2:2 honours degree (2:1 preferred)
* have GCSE grade C/grade 4 in English Language and Maths
attributes.assessment_methods: Over the course of the programme, you will complete two academic assignments amounting to 60 credits at Master’s level alongside compiling a portfolio linking subject specific educational theory with teaching practice.
attributes.duration_per_school: Placements are completed across three phases and will take place in at least two placement schools. The course is designed for you to spend 120 days on placement across all three phases.
attributes.fee_schedule:
International Applicants:

International applicants must pay a minimum financial deposit to secure their place. The deadline will be confirmed on our corporate website.
attributes.interview_process:
During the PGCE interview process, the course tutors will be looking for a wide range of qualities that would make you a good teacher. These qualities include a passion for teaching, confidence, resilience, adaptability and good communication skills to name just a few. In preparation for your interview, you may wish to develop your understanding of current educational issues. On the day we will be looking for your enthusiasm for teaching young people and your ability to reflect on your experiences of education. 

The interview process will be used to determine your suitability for teaching and includes  
* an introduction to the course 

* identity checks 

* a short presentation related to your subject 

* a subject knowledge activity 

* an individual interview 

* an independent task

All candidates will be sent further information about what will be expected prior to the interview date.
attributes.placement_school_activities:
During school-based placements you will carry out a period of observation followed by team teaching and then whole class teaching as your placements progress. You will work closely with staff in school to develop your understanding of teaching and learning as well as developing your understanding of your role within the wider school community.  

Throughout each phase of training you will reflect on ongoing dialogue and feedback which will be recorded on an online platform with the support of a specialist subject mentor. 

At the end of the period of training you will be assessed holistically against the Teachers’ Standards.
attributes.placement_selection_criteria: Our dedicated placements team select the schools you will be teaching in based on the school’s ability to offer good support to trainee teachers as well as your own personal circumstances such as your home address and mode of transport.
attributes.support_and_mentorship: During your school-based placement you are closely supported by expert school and university mentors during each school placement. We take a research-informed approach to mentoring and coaching and employ a dialogic model which is centred around collaboration, discussion, and reflection, supported by regular mentor-mentee meetings and ongoing dialogue.
attributes.theoretical_training_activities:
The University of Chester and its Partnership is committed to achieving the highest quality education and training for our future teachers, supported by University staff and School-Based Mentors who will consistently and skilfully draw upon their knowledge and expertise. 

 

The modules on the PGCE Secondary course will provide you with: 

* critical understanding of pedagogy, assessment and curriculum 

* critical knowledge, understanding and skills in your specialist subject 

* critical knowledge and understanding of wider professional issues, for example, behaviour management and inclusive practices 

* an understanding of the link between theory and practice through intensive training and practice opportunities.
attributes.theoretical_training_location:
Learning takes place within University at our Exton Park Campus and in Partnership settings via lectures, seminars, practical workshops and tutorials.  

In additional to timetabled lectures and seminars you will be expected to undertake independent preparation and consolidation study hours each week.
